items.title: Samsung Biologics: geographic diversification is a sound business decision
items.summary: Samsung Biologics has been on a steep upward growth trajectory since receiving its first licence to produce biologic drug substances in 2015.

items.title: US generic tariff reprieve on the rocks as Trump proposes 100% rate in 2028
items.summary: If introduced, the 100% tariffs would apply to all generic drugs imported to the US, which make up 90% of the nation’s prescriptions.

items.title: Kyowa Kirin EMEA’s Crysvita approved by EC for infants with XLH
items.summary: Kyowa Kirin EMEA, a subsidiary of Kyowa Kirin, has received approval from the EC to expand the use of Crysvita for treating XLH in infants aged one month to one year across the EU and European Economic Area.

items.title: Cellares and Papillon partner for PPL-001 manufacturing automation
items.summary: Cellares and Papillon Therapeutics have entered into a partnership to automate the manufacturing of PPL-001, an investigational therapy developed by the latter for FA, a rare inherited neurodegenerative disorder.

items.title: Novo sues Lilly after alleged misleading and false advertising campaign
items.summary: In a lawsuit filed in the US, Novo alleged that Lilly’s campaign was designed to mislead consumers on “comparative efficacy” of drug brands.
